title: fix: align protocol bridges and CRM example with @objectstack/spec v4 string labels
body:
`@objectstack/spec` v4 changed `I18nLabel` from `{ key: string; defaultValue: string }` to plain `string`. This broke builds and tests across core protocols, console app, and the CRM example.

### Core protocol bridges (`@object-ui/core`)

Removed translation object resolution from `DndProtocol`, `KeyboardProtocol`, and `NotificationProtocol` — fields like `ariaLabel`, `label`, `title`, `message` are now passed through directly as strings.

```ts
// Before
const ariaLabel = typeof item.ariaLabel === 'string'
  ? item.ariaLabel
  : item.ariaLabel?.defaultValue;

// After
'aria-label': item.ariaLabel ?? item.label,
```

### CRM example

Converted all 19+ i18n label objects in `crm.app.ts` and `crm.dashboard.ts` to their `defaultValue` strings.

```ts
// Before
label: { key: 'crm.navigation.dashboard', defaultValue: 'Dashboard' }
// After
label: 'Dashboard'
```

### Console app

- `MetadataService.ts`: Cast `DesignerFieldDefinition.defaultValue` (`unknown`) to `string | undefined` for the API payload type
- Removed unused imports (`toast`, `MetadataFormFieldDef`, `MetadataActionDef`) causing `TS6133`

### Tests

Updated protocol test cases and CRM test helper to use plain strings instead of translation objects.
